about_short_description.short_description: NoorDx offers advanced genetic diagnostic testing laboratory with an aim to provide precision medicine capabilities for the Middle East.

product.name: Whole Exome Sequencing (WES)
product.description: A genetic test analyzing the protein-coding regions of DNA to identify variants linked to medical conditions, enabling rapid diagnosis of rare diseases.

product.name: Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS)
product.description: A comprehensive genetic test analyzing the entire genome to diagnose genetically complex and undiagnosed cases with high certainty.

product.name: Genetic Counseling
product.description: A service providing guidance and support throughout the genetic testing process, helping patients understand results and treatment options.

product.name: BRAF V600E Variant Detection
product.description: A genetic test detecting BRAF V600E mutations to assist in diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment selection for certain cancers.

identifier.value: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) Deletion Duplication Analysis

product.name: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) Deletion Duplication Analysis
product.description: A test detecting deletions or duplications in the DMD gene for diagnosing Duchenne or Becker muscular dystrophy and carrier status.

product.name: Metagenomic Screening
product.description: A genomic test using whole-genome sequencing to identify infectious agents directly from patient samples for clinical microbiology.
